name: Broad Street Shopping Center
summary: Broad Street Shopping Center is a neighborhood retail destination on East Broad Street in Mansfield, Texas, offering convenient access to everyday shopping and services. With strong community ratings and consistent hours, it serves as a reliable retail hub for southeastern Tarrant County residents.
demographics: Broad Street Shopping Center serves the growing Mansfield, Texas community, attracting primarily middle-income families and young professionals in the 25-54 age range with household incomes between $60,000-$100,000. The trade area draws from southeastern Tarrant County and northern Johnson County, with visitors typically combining shopping trips with errands at nearby service retailers. The center appeals to value-conscious shoppers seeking convenience and accessibility for everyday needs, with strong weekday afternoon and weekend traffic patterns typical of suburban neighborhood centers.
description: Broad Street Shopping Center is a well-established retail destination located at 2751 East Broad Street in Mansfield, Texas, serving the rapidly growing southeastern Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex. Strategically positioned along one of Mansfield's primary commercial corridors, the center provides convenient access to essential retail and services for the surrounding residential communities. With a solid 4.4-star rating from over 172 Google reviews, the shopping center has earned a reputation for reliability and accessibility among local residents. The center maintains consistent operating hours from 9:30 AM to 9:30 PM, accommodating both working professionals and families throughout the week. Managed by CBRE Retail Properties, Broad Street Shopping Center represents a stable neighborhood retail hub that continues to serve the everyday needs of Mansfield's diverse and expanding population.
